messages:
Devon (People Ops): Quick org note: we're combining Product Analytics and Platform PMs into a single Product Operations org under Leah Park, effective 2026-04-06. This is a lateral consolidation to improve cross-team program delivery.
Leah Park: Honored to take this on. My focus first 30 days = roadmap alignment, shared metrics, and cleaning up duplicate OKRs. Happy to meet 1:1s to hear pain points.
Oliver Grant: Im transitioning off the team to pursue a startup opportunity. My last day is 4/17. Ill stay on through handoffs and recruiting support. Huge thanks everyone 8591;
Nina S.: Congrats Leah, and congrats/bittersweet for Oliver! Any immediate changes to who we ping for program blockers?
Leah Park: Short term: Samir will take point for cross-functional scheduling and the weekly sync while we post the open PM role. Oliver and I will run handoffs for active projects.
Samir Rao: Ill own the weekly sync starting next Tue and update the shared agenda. Also will coordinate backlog triage sessions.
Devon (People Ops): Hiring plan: opening two roles today  1) Senior Product Manager (Platform) and 2) Program Manager (Contract, 6 months) to cover execution bandwidth. Expect interview loop ~3 weeks. Internal ref bonus applies.
Leah Park: We'll post a public hiring doc with role bullets + candidate profile in #eng-releases and the jobs board by EOD. Folks: if you have quick candidate recs, DM Devon.
Oliver Grant: Im creating a short handoff checklist and dropping it in the team drive: /drive/product-ops/oliver-handoff.md. Includes active tickets, stakeholders, and decision logs.
Nina S.: Can we get clarity on title/reporting for current Platform PMs?
Devon (People Ops): Titles unchanged for now. Reporting lines: everyone on the Platform PM roster will report to Leah. People Ops will post org chart update and payroll/reporting change deadline = 2026-04-01.
Samir Rao: Noted. Any changes to oncall or pager duties for the PM rotation?
Leah Park: No oncall changes this sprint. We will revisit responsibilities during the 30/60 plan.
Devon (People Ops): Action items: 1) People Ops post updated org chart (by 4/1). 2) Leah publish 30/60 plan (by 4/3). 3) Oliver upload handoff doc (by 3/28). 4) Hiring reqs live (today). Please follow the hiring checklist in HR Confluence.
HRbot: Reminder  please complete the org change form in Workday by 2026-04-01 to ensure manager changes and benefits flow correctly.
Leah Park: Thanks everyone. Open to 1:1s this week for context, shout if you want a slot.
